कृवध्वंस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
 1. Defeated, overpowered.
 2. Injured, destroyed.
3. Recollecting past transactions.
 E. कृत, and ध्वंस loss.

कृव r. 1st cl. or 5th cl. (इ) कृवि (कृणोति) 1. To kill, to hurt or injure in
any way.
 2. To act, to do.
 3. To go, to move.
 4. To be in pain.
कृवि r. 5th cl. (कृविणोति) To want to hurt or kill.

कृवि m. (-विः) A loom.
 E. कृ to make, (cloth,) and क्विन् Uṇādi aff.
